findings.highlight: Biting. Sucking.
findings.evidenceJa: つう、と。
findings.governingReading: After Rider's mouth is placed at the neck, つう、と depicts the thin red stream trickling down.
findings.explanation: A thin trickle of blood becomes the actions biting and sucking.

findings.highlight: "Well, well. If it isn't Emiya. I'm amazed your bumbling has gotten you this far."
findings.evidenceJa: 「—へえ。誰かと思えば衛宮じゃないか。凄いな、おまえの間の悪さもここまで来ると長所だね」
findings.governingReading: Shinji sarcastically says Shirou's extraordinarily bad timing has reached the point of being a talent.
findings.explanation: Shinji's mock praise of Shirou's spectacularly bad timing becomes surprise that an incompetent person has made it this far.

findings.highlight: "C'mon, show me what you got, Emiya. I went to all this trouble because I want to see Servants fight. Aren't you a Master? What are you shaking in your boots for? Makes you no different from that 'girl' there!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「ほら、戦わせてみようぜ衛宮。僕はサーヴァント同士の戦いが見たくて人を呼んだんだ。おまえだってマスターだろ？　なのにぶるぶる震えてさ、そんなんじゃそこの女と変わらないじゃないか！」
findings.governingReading: Shinji says he called people there because he wanted to see Servants fight.
findings.explanation: Shinji's use of people to summon spectators disappears.

findings.highlight: The enemy's long hair whips through the air, hounding her cautious prey.
findings.evidenceJa: 敵は長い髪をなびかせ、鈍重な獲物を追い詰めるように畳み掛けてくる。
findings.governingReading: Rider presses the attack as if cornering slow and heavy prey.
findings.explanation: A slow, lumbering target becomes a cautious target.

findings.highlight: I've followed Grandpa's orders! You're unstoppable enough to take out Emiya's Servant!"
findings.evidenceJa: 爺さんの言いつけは守ったんだ、衛宮のサーヴァントを始末するぐらい不可抗力さ！」
findings.governingReading: Shinji claims compliance with his grandfather's instructions and excuses killing Shirou's Servant as something unavoidable.
findings.explanation: Shinji's excuse that killing Saber would be unavoidable becomes praise of Rider as unstoppable. Rider still obeys his order in the next sentence.

findings.highlight: Shinji runs over to Rider and screams at her. She's sprawled on the ground, her belly cut open.
findings.evidenceJa: 腹を裂かれ、深手を負ったライダーに駆け寄ることなく慎二が叫ぶ。
findings.governingReading: Shinji screams without going over to Rider, whose abdomen has been cut and who is badly wounded.
findings.explanation: Shinji not running to wounded Rider becomes running to her.

findings.highlight: Rider writhes with pain as blue-white lightning wrecks her body, punishing her for failing to comply with Shinji's command.
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の命令を守れない罰なのか、ライダーは青白い電荷に苛まれる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether the blue-white charge tormenting Rider is punishment for being unable to obey Shinji.
findings.explanation: A possible punishment becomes an asserted punishment.

findings.highlight: Her body begins to move, her death ever more certain.
findings.evidenceJa: —死を前提とした命令に、ライダーの体が動く。
findings.governingReading: Rider's body moves in response to an order premised on her death: die while taking Saber with her.
findings.explanation: A death-premised command moving Rider becomes her death growing more certain.

findings.highlight: "Enough. It seems you weren't useful after all, Shinji."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そこまでだ。どうやらおまえでは宝の持ち腐れだったようじゃな、慎二」
findings.governingReading: Zouken says Rider was wasted in Shinji's hands—宝の持ち腐れ, possession of a treasure one cannot use.
findings.explanation: A treasure wasted on Shinji becomes Shinji himself being useless.

findings.highlight: Shinji scrambles over the old man as if clinging to his feet.
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は縋るように老人に駆け寄る。
findings.governingReading: Shinji runs to Zouken as if clinging to him for protection.
findings.explanation: Running up to the old man becomes scrambling over him.

findings.highlight: Saber shifts slightly backward, as if repulsed by him.
findings.evidenceJa: ……老人に不吉なものを感じたのか、セイバーはかすかに後じさる。
findings.governingReading: Saber backs away slightly, apparently sensing something sinister or ill-omened in Zouken.
findings.explanation: Sensing something ominous becomes being repulsed.

findings.highlight: "...Hm, I see. It's little wonder Rider lost. You are a Heroic Spirit of some renown. I seem to recall a Servant as powerful as this in one of the past wars."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……ふむ。なるほど、これではライダーが敗れるのも道理。さぞ名のある英霊とお見受けした。これほどのサーヴァント、過去の戦いにおいても一人現れたかどうか」
findings.governingReading: Zouken judges that perhaps not even one Servant of Saber's caliber appeared in past wars.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty whether even one comparable Servant appeared becomes a recalled definite example.

findings.highlight: "Still, I can't simply let him die. He is still my flesh and blood, as sad as that is. I will risk myself to preserve his life, at least. Haha. Family love truly is a matter of life and death."
findings.evidenceJa: 「さて、となるとワシは死ななくてはなるまい。あのようなものでも血縁でな、この身に代えても命だけは救わねばならぬ。カカ、まっこと肉親の情とは命取りよ」
findings.governingReading: Zouken theatrically announces that he must die, then says he must save his blood relative even at the cost of his own body.
findings.explanation: Zouken's theatrical claim that he must die for Shinji becomes a promise to risk himself. The family obligation remains, but the announced sacrifice is less absolute.

findings.highlight: She's probably decided—for my sake—that Shinji isn't worth pursuing now that he's no longer a Master.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターでなくなった慎二を追う必要はない、と考えてくれたのだろう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou supposes she judged there was no need to pursue Shinji now that he was no longer a Master.
findings.explanation: Saber's decision not to pursue Shinji gains a for-my-sake motive.

findings.highlight: When he learned of the Holy Grail, he—not I—made a contract with a Servant. Like you, he is the last of a line walking the ways of the wise.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯が現れると知り、ワシではなく孫にサーヴァントと契約させたのだ。おぬしとて魔道を究める血の末席。
findings.governingReading: Zouken says he learned the Grail would appear and had his grandson contract in his place. He then addresses Shirou as someone belonging to a magical lineage.
findings.explanation: Zouken's account of learning about the Grail and arranging his grandson's contract becomes an account centered on Shinji's actions. The preceding admission that Zouken selected him survives, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of Zouken's agency.

findings.highlight: Ah, yes. They let us adopt one of their
findings.evidenceJa: おお、たしか彼奴から小娘に代替わりしたのであっ
findings.governingReading: Zouken recalls that leadership had passed from that man to the young girl; the split Japanese line completes 代替わりしたのであったな.
findings.explanation: A change of Tohsaka family head becomes adoption of a daughter by Matou.

findings.highlight: I wonder how much of a mage their apprentice has grown into these past ten years."
findings.evidenceJa: ここ十年ばかり留守にしておった故、彼奴の弟子がどれほどの器かは見知らぬが」
findings.governingReading: Zouken attributes his unfamiliarity with the previous head's apprentice to having been away for about ten years.
findings.explanation: Zouken's claim that he has been away for roughly ten years disappears. The same interval instead describes the apprentice's growth, changing his explanation for his limited knowledge.

findings.highlight: Zouken Matou laughs in amusement at whatever the Tohsaka family must be feeling.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の家にどんな感情を抱いているのか、間桐臓硯は愉快そうに哄笑する。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot tell what feelings Zouken holds toward the Tohsaka family as Zouken laughs with apparent pleasure.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about Zouken's feelings toward the Tohsakas becomes amusement at their presumed feelings. This supplies a target for his laughter that the Japanese leaves open.

findings.highlight: "What an odd question. Sakura, a Master? That's inconcievable. It seems your father didn't give you a proper education."
findings.evidenceJa: 「これは異な事を。桜がマスターだと？　そのような事はあり得まいに。どうやらおぬしの父親は、まともな教育をしなかったようじゃな」
findings.governingReading: Both lines use the ordinary English word inconceivable while Zouken denies Sakura could be a Master and Shirou repeats it.
findings.explanation: The same conspicuous spelling error appears twice in the Sakura denial exchange.

findings.highlight: That's doubly so for siblings. There is no need for two heirs. If the Matou name hadn't declined, then we might have been able to adopt someone, but we don't have any Magic Circuits to pass on to begin with."
findings.evidenceJa: 兄妹など最たるものだ。後継ぎは二人もいらぬ。間桐の名が廃れていなければ養子にでも出したのだが、魔術回路がないのでは貰い手などおるまい」
findings.governingReading: Zouken says the unselected sibling could have been sent out for adoption, but no receiving family would want someone without circuits. The surrounding questions identify Sakura as the person under discussion.
findings.explanation: Zouken's account of sending Sakura to another family becomes an account of the Matous adopting someone. The stated obstacle also changes from the prospective adoptee's lack of circuits to the family's lack of circuits to pass on.

findings.highlight: "Shinji is the Master, so the conclusion is obvious. A sibling not even chosen as the heir would not be inducted into our arts.
findings.evidenceJa: 「慎二はマスターである以上、答えは明白であろう。後継者に選ばれなかった片割れは、間桐の家が魔道である事も知らぬわ。
findings.governingReading: Zouken claims the sibling not chosen as heir does not even know that the Matou household belongs to the magical path.
findings.explanation: Not knowing that Matou practices magecraft becomes merely not being taught its arts.

findings.highlight: "...By jove, where did he even learn of such secrets? His head is filled with conceits of being a chosen one, even as he grapples with the inferiority complex of being taught how flawed he was from birth.
findings.evidenceJa: 「……まったく、だというのに何処で秘伝を紐解いたのか。アレは選ばれた人間などという驕りを持ちながら、同時に生まれつき劣っているという強迫観念を持って育ちおった。
findings.governingReading: Zouken says Shinji grew up simultaneously arrogant that he was chosen and compulsively convinced he was inferior by birth.
findings.explanation: An inborn-inferiority obsession becomes something Shinji was taught.

findings.highlight: "In any case, Shinji has lost. We intend to withdraw early from the war this time...but you would still cut this old man down, Saber?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「ともあれ、慎二は敗れた。此度の戦いは早々に我らの敗退となったが—それでもこの老体を斬るかね、セイバーのサーヴァントよ」
findings.governingReading: Zouken says Shinji has lost and Matou's participation in this war has consequently ended early, then asks whether Saber will still cut him down.
findings.explanation: An already concluded defeat becomes an intended withdrawal.

findings.highlight: Saber takes the woman and starts running.
findings.evidenceJa: 女性をセイバーに預けて走り出す。
findings.governingReading: Shirou entrusts the woman to Saber and sets off running; she then announces she will lead and moves ahead.
findings.explanation: Shirou starting to run after handing over the woman becomes Saber starting to run.
